name: dForce LPCurveGaugeAggregatorModel read-only reentrancy
summary: dForce's new Curve wstETH/ETH vault market priced collateral with LPCurveGaugeAggregatorModel, which reads get_virtual_price with no reentrancy check. The attacker borrowed USX against vault collateral, then, from remove_liquidity's ETH callback with the price distorted, liquidated its own and other users' positions to seize collateral; it repeated this on Optimism.
notes: The vault market (controller, iToken, iMUSX) launched two days before the exploit; the latest wiring it needed was the MSDController mint cap granting iMUSX the right to mint USX. A fork replay of the anchor with that cap cleared reverts; the model, oracle aggregator and market listings are older.

Loss per chain: vault shares (1:1 with the Curve LP) seized from other depositors at the DefiLlama LP price, plus USX minted net of burns (which nets the users' debt the liquidations repaid) at par. Collateral the attacker left behind and its post-bounty return of funds are not netted.
The Optimism leg 40 seconds later used the same attacker contract against dForce's mirror vault market (same bug and codebase), so it joins this incident's campaign.
